name: case-study-01
title: Case Study 01 - A Customer, An Account And The Figures They Assert
description: One case study in full: a named customer, a sector, the problem, what was done, a row of figures the caller asserts and an optionally labelled quotation, stacked or split. Every number is a prop and none is shipped here, because a figure a design system chose would be a false advertising claim installed into every consumer product. quoteLabel is required with a quotation.
